research.searchCoverage: Official Checkout.com NAS unique base URLs ({prefix}.api.checkout.com and {prefix}.api.sandbox.checkout.com), Secret API Key Bearer auth, GET /customers/{identifier}, Checkout Ltd London identity, November 2025 ShinyHunters legacy third-party cloud storage incident with vendor statement that the live payment platform, merchant funds, and card numbers were not accessed, and dated incident search (Checkout.com + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Pinned source computes the host from environment plus an 8-character caller-supplied prefix. Algolia bounded-wildcard + required stored id covers only one parent domain at a time; official NAS requires both production and sandbox parents, and prefixes differ per environment. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official NAS unique hosts, Secret API Key Bearer, GET /customers/{identifier}, Checkout Ltd identity, and dated November 2025 ShinyHunters legacy-storage coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. Pinned OpenConnector computes https://{prefix}.{api|api.sandbox}.checkout.com from environment plus an 8-character prefix. Native cannot express environment-dependent parent domains. Algolia bounded-wildcard + required stored id does not cover both official NAS parents. Pinned credential validator treats HTTP 404 plus cko-request-id as success.

incidents.affectedProduct: Checkout.com legacy third-party cloud file storage (used 2020 and prior; not the live payments API)
incidents.affectedData: Internal operational documents and merchant onboarding materials, including some KYC identity copies from 2010-2019. Checkout estimated fewer than 25% of the then-current merchant base. Merchant funds and card numbers were not accessed.
incidents.status: confirmed historical legacy-storage incident; live payment processing platform not impacted per vendor statement
incidents.remediation: Vendor investigation, merchant notification, law-enforcement and regulator engagement, ransom refused, equivalent donation to Carnegie Mellon and Oxford cybercrime research.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical onboarding/KYC document exposure for a subset of merchants. Not a current NAS Customers API compromise. Computed NAS hosts remain unsupported regardless of incident status.

remainingGates: boundedNetwork: pinned OpenConnector computes apiBaseUrl as https://{prefix}.{api|api.sandbox}.checkout.com from required environment (sandbox|production) plus an 8-character caller-supplied prefix (first eight characters of client_id after cli_). Official NAS parents are {prefix}.api.checkout.com and {prefix}.api.sandbox.checkout.com, and prefixes differ per environment. Native templates cannot express that environment-dependent parent domain. Algolia bounded-wildcard + required stored id would cover only one parent at a time and is not an official single-host edition.
